lines.en: I’m wide awake, it’s morning — and while the clouds are here to greet me, joined by the light and the wind, I fight them away and embrace my role as everyone’s favorite half-tangible parasite.
Today, I will find a host. I will burrow into their flesh and take up residence in some hard-to-reach place, living off of their blood instead of my own because mine scares me sometimes.
Sometimes, I feel like there’s more to it than its color. Its viscosity. How I can’t live without it and yet, how knowing it’s there makes my skin try to crawl away.
But such a feat is impossible as only ghosts can escape themselves. So while I long for the day where I can roam the halls of the dead, for now I have the clouds.
The light.
The wind.
And a phone call from a good friend.
: Hello?
: Wakana? Are you there?
: Arakawa...
: You’re not busy today, are you?
: I mean...I’m rarely busy at all these days. Aren’t you normally in school around this time, though?
: It’s Saturday. But I suppose you wouldn’t know that if the days of your prolonged absence have begun to congeal into some indiscernible blob.
: I know it’s Saturday. But you’re normally still over there, like...watering your plants or grading papers. Stuff like that.
: I don’t have anything to grade right now...and I watered my plants before I left the building yesterday. I can leave them alone until tomorrow.
: Okay. So...why are you calling, then? You don’t normally do that unless you need my help with something.
: Can you come over?
: To your place?
: That is correct.
: You don’t need my help cooking again, do you?
: It’s not like that, I-
: I could just really use the company.
: But if you already have plans, it’s-
: No, I’ll head over now. Does that work?
: It doesn’t have to be now. Any time you-
: Nope. Getting dressed and coming over now. You can deal with me when I get there.
: Arakawa-
I hang up the phone and throw on the same outfit as always, but I grab an umbrella out of the closet as well since I’d be crazy to not expect rain when the clouds have already turned grey.
Surely, that was Wakana’s doing. And surely I shouldn’t question why when I’ve already learned the reason for the cracks in her sky.
But if I’m to keep her out of the rain, which is surely why she needs me now, it’s best that I stay dry.
I can’t imagine she’d take kindly to me tracking mud all over her floors.
: Thanks for coming. I can make tea to repay you, if you’d like.
: I’m good. But I do take exception to the implication that you’d only offer me a drink if you owe me something.
: I only keep the expensive stuff in here. The kind that would be lost on someone like you. So forgive me for keeping it to myself on most occasions.
: You are forgiven. Now, what’s going on?
: I need you to clean my shower.
: Ahh, okay.
: And it would be great if you could wash the floors while you’re at it.
: Anything else?
: If you could get inside the oven, that would be greatly appreciated as well.
: As in...cleaning it? Or literally getting inside of the oven so you can kill me?
: I suppose the former as burning you to a crisp would surely make the oven even harder to clean.
: Your wish is my command, Wakana.
: You’re being awfully obedient today.
: Yeah, well you’re looking awfully pathetic.
: You always look awfully pathetic.
: You’re right. Which is precisely why I know to go along with anything you say right now as it probably feels nice to have some power back, doesn’t it?
: Are you okay?
: No.
: And since you’ve managed to figure that out all on your own, I suppose you can forgo all of the cleaning and just...sit with me for a little while.
: Lead the way, princess.
: Please don’t ever call me “princess” again — even in the midst of my most miserable days.
: Are any of your days better than “miserable?” Because my understanding was that was just the baseline.
: And it normally is...
: But things have been exponentially worse lately and I...may be having a difficult time getting adjusted to that.
Wakana and I take a seat on the couch and she immediately pulls her knees up to her chest.
And while this may make it a little harder for me to find a soft spot to burrow into and start living off of her blood, I have faith I’ll figure it out soon enough.
But who knows? Maybe if I can get a strong enough taste of whatever she’s feeling from a few inches away, I won’t have to do that at all.
: Osako, I’m guessing?
: I heard the two of you went out the other night...
: Wait. You’re not...jealous, are you?
: What? Don’t be ridiculous. Osako wouldn’t fall for you even if you had the correct genitalia.
: Then why did you sound so forlorn when you mentioned the two of us meeting just now?
: I wasn’t trying to sound forlorn. I was just using that as a bridge to...acknowledge that you likely understand what the two of us are going through right now.
: I’ve known since the beach trip that things haven’t been perfect. I just don’t fully understand why. But I guess that’s between you two and not me.
: Things have been...imperfect for several months now. But it wasn’t until after that trip that they...really started to change.
: And I guess I’m just...so used to the way they’ve always been that seeing her trying to better herself has set off something in my brain that’s making me think all of this is wrong.
: Well...she made it sound like she was the issue in the first place. Which is why she’s doing all of this to begin with, right?
: She’s not the only issue. I have my fair share of faults as well. I just worry that...I may have been a little too harsh on her.
: So that’s what this is? Just...general worrying? No earth-shattering revelations or drama for me to help you with?
: Does that come as a disappointment?
: I’d say it’s a relief, if anything.
: Yes, well...I wouldn’t be too relieved if I were you.
: From the outside, I’m sure it’s easy to look at this as the two of us “trying to work through something,” but we’ve worked through plenty of things in the past and it’s never felt like this...
: So...perhaps it’s just the eternal pessimist in me that’s perceiving it as some sort of omen. I hope that’s the case. Regardless, I needed someone to steel my heart for me, so...here you are.
: I get it. I’m just surprised you’d trust me with something like that over Imani.
: Imani has her strengths, and she’s better than you in more ways than I can count.
: But you’re the one I’m more comfortable with, Arakawa.
: Uhh...why?
: I suppose you just feel like a brother to me. A cousin, perhaps? But I can rest my head on your shoulder like this and feel absolutely nothing.
: You have a real gift for accidentally insulting people, Wakana.
: It was a joke, idiot. I don’t feel nothing. I feel...secure. And as great of a friend Imani is, it never really feels as if she’s watching over me, you know?
: I’m sorry for being the way I am. You’re extremely special to me.
: Maybe be a little less sorry if possible, though. Because if I have to deal with you and Osako going through monumental personality changes at once, I’m not sure how I’m going to process it.
: I’ll go back to normal shortly. I just wanted to be vulnerable for a little while. And while all logic says I should do that as far away from you as possible, I decided to challenge it.
: Okay. But if your girlfriend comes through that door and sees you cozying up to me, you have to explain everything in five seconds or I am very likely going to die.
: I’ll see what I can do.
: That doesn’t bode well for my future. But I’ll take it, I guess.
: Arakawa...can I ask you something?
: Nope. I just came over here to eat your food and watch your TV.
: I guess I can humor you if you keep it brief, though.
: Then...
: I just wanted to know if you’d think any less of me if I forced you to hold me so I can cry into your chest for a little while.
: Do I even have the right to refuse? Because you’re already changing positions and-
: Nope. Here I come. Move your legs.
: Where? There’s nowhere to go.
: Well, figure it out because I’m only a few seconds away from a full-on breakdown and I’d like you to close your eyes for it so you can preserve your image of me.
: But the image I have of you sucks.
: Then maybe you’ll just have to hate me after today...
Wakana quite literally crawls into my lap and finds a place to nestle herself between my legs.
When she presses her head against my shoulder, I don’t hesitate to hold her close and stroke her hair.
And yes, it...feels a little odd doing this for someone who, for the most part, has always seemed rather stoic. But there have been breaks in that that I’ve experienced over the years.
And I know what it’s like to bottle things up for so long that the pressure just becomes too much. So I won’t think any less of her for being a little more human than normal now.
I’m just thankful and...surprised that she’s willing to break in front of me.
For while I might not be good at collecting and reassembling the pieces, I love the way they look when the light hits them just right.
For each tear that dribbles down her cheek, I make a wish on her behalf.
I wish for her happiness. I wish that her love survives. I wish that one day, if we can ever make it out of this place, that we can hold each other again somewhere closer to our deaths.
But most of all, I just wish for her to stop crying so I can stop coming up with wishes that might never come true.
: You’re not holding me tight enough...
: Yeah well, look at how you’re sitting. What do you want me to do?
: Hold me tighter, idiot! Squeeze the life out of me! I need it!
: You need to be squeezed to death?
: Yes! Haven’t you ever been sad before?!
: Of course. But normally when I wish for death, I do it in a less cute way.
: Yeah, well I’m a cute girl and you’re a stupid, terrible, horrible man! Hug me harder!
: You get really needy when you cry, huh?
: I’m really needy all the time. I just never ask for anything because everyone other than me is incompetent.
: Does that mean I have the green light to just hug you whenever I want then?
: Maybe...Not if anyone else is around, though. I don’t want anybody to know I actually really like you.
: Yeah, why do you like me anyway?
: Shut up, Arakawa. This is my time to be sad. We’re talking about me right now. So shower me in compliments until I stop crying. That’s an order.
: Uhh...
: You’re...really smart.
: More.
: You’ve...got a really nice figure?
: More. But less creepy.
: You...smell nice?
: I just told you to be less creepy! How can you be this bad at simply hugging someone?!
Things carry on that way for another thirty minutes or so before Wakana swiftly tears herself away from me and-
: That never happened.
And goes back to being Wakana.
: Feel any better now?
Instead of pressing her about it and capitalizing on my free hug pass, though, I skip right to the point. Because, the quicker she feels normal, the quicker things become normal.
And if I’m going to be following Osako on her path to self-acceptance, I don’t want any commentary to lead me down some road less traveled.
: Maybe.
: Maybe?
: How have you made it this far into adulthood without knowing how to properly hug someone?
: Probably because my brand of physical affection is best received by people who aren’t already in committed relationships.
Except for Haruka. But I’m pretty sure she wouldn’t have it any other way at this point.
: Save it for Imani, you devious disgrace of a man.
: Sure. Will you be there to hold her hand again, though? Because that made it really fun last time, didn’t it?
: I can’t believe I allowed you to see my naked body — even in the throes of a foursome.
: I can’t believe Osako allowed me to see your naked body. That’s the real surprise here.
: Yeah, that was...odd. But I suppose it...might have been her first step?
: Not gonna lie, that is one hell of a “first step.” Usually it’s haircut first, foursome second.
: Yeah...but that’s another reason why I’m...
: No, fuck it. No more of this depressing stuff. There’s enough of that to go around already. What we need is food and alcohol.
: Have we already reached that point of the recovery process?
: I demand sustenance, Arakawa. If I am going to spend my day off with the likes of you, I am going to need all the energy I can get.
: Fine by me. I skipped breakfast to come here. Is there anywhere you have in mind, though?
: You choose. I’m too hungry to think.
: Okay...I’ve got somewhere in mind.
: It’s a bit of a trip, though.
Wakana’s affection has increased to [wakana_love]!
